segments.speaker: Maya Chen, Rep
segments.text:
Hi Daniel,

Maya

The $46,800 annual we landed on over text works. I’ll send the order form at that amount now and clean up the deal desk approval after so we don’t miss your June 28 PO cutoff.

Maya

segments.text:
Okay, that works.

Please make the bill-to:
Northbridge Components, Inc.
1180 Larkin Road
Columbus, OH 43215

Payment terms should be net 30 if available.

Daniel

segments.speaker: Maya Chen, Rep
segments.text:
Net 30 is included. I also added the billing address and set the initial term for July 15, 2026 through July 14, 2027.

Order form is attached for signature.

Maya

segments.speaker: Daniel Ortiz, Customer
segments.text:

Daniel

segments.text:
Yes. Additional seats can be added during the term at the same prorated per-seat rate through the coterm date. No minimum for the add-on.

Maya

segments.text:
Great. Signed copy attached.

Please send the invoice to ap@northbridgecomponents.com and copy me.

Daniel

segments.speaker: Maya Chen, Rep
segments.text:
Thanks, Daniel. Countersigned copy attached.

Invoice will go to AP today, and I’ll introduce your implementation lead for the July 8 admin training.

Maya
